question.:question/problem:
Consider the vectors

$$
{a}_{1}=\begin{bmatrix}3 \\ 4 \\ 2\end{bmatrix},\,{a}_{2}=\begin{bmatrix}-2 \\ 3 \\ -3\end{bmatrix},\,b=\begin{bmatrix}-12 \\ 28 \\ -22\end{bmatrix}.
$$

If ${x}_{1}{a}_{1}+{x}_{2}{a}_{2}=b,$ then what is ${x}_{1}+{x}_{2}?$
question.:question/worked-solution:
If ${x}_{1}{a}_{1}+{x}_{2}{a}_{2}=b$, then we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}\begin{bmatrix}3 \\ 4 \\ 2\end{bmatrix}+{x}_{2}\begin{bmatrix}-2 \\ 3 \\ -3\end{bmatrix} &=\begin{bmatrix}-12 \\ 28 \\ -22\end{bmatrix} \\ \begin{bmatrix}3{x}_{1} \\ 4{x}_{1} \\ 2{x}_{1}\end{bmatrix}+\begin{bmatrix}-2{x}_{2} \\ 3{x}_{2} \\ -3{x}_{2}\end{bmatrix} &=\begin{bmatrix}-12 \\ 28 \\ -22\end{bmatrix} \\ \begin{bmatrix}3{x}_{1}-2{x}_{2} \\ 4{x}_{1}+3{x}_{2} \\ 2{x}_{1}-3{x}_{2}\end{bmatrix} &=\begin{bmatrix}-12 \\ 28 \\ -22\end{bmatrix}\end{aligned}
$$

Equating the corresponding components, we get the following system:

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}3{x}_{1}-2{x}_{2} &=-12 \\ 4{x}_{1}+3{x}_{2} &=28 \\ 2{x}_{1}-3{x}_{2} &=-22\end{aligned}\right.
$$

Adding the second and the third equations we get

$$
\begin{aligned}6{x}_{1} &=6 \\ {x}_{1} &=1\end{aligned}
$$

Substituting ${x}_{1}=1$ into the second equation, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}4{x}_{1}+3{x}_{2} &=28 \\ 4(1)+3{x}_{2} &=28 \\ 3{x}_{2} &=24 \\ {x}_{2} &=8\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we substitute ${x}_{1}=1$ and ${x}_{2}=8$ into the first equation to get

$$
\begin{aligned}3{x}_{1}-2{x}_{2} &=-12 \\ 3(1)-2(8) &=-12 \\ -13 &=-12\end{aligned}
$$

which gives a false statement.

So, the system has no solution.
